installSteps: Download the APK on your Android phone and open the downloaded file.
If Android asks, allow this browser or file manager to install apps, then follow the installer.
Open BYD and sign in to your own account. Go to Me → Settings to choose your language and bottom tabs.
existing: Updating a compatible project build? Keep your existing app and install over it to preserve local settings. This release uses the same project signing key.
original: Using the original BYD app? Uninstall it before installing this APK because the signing keys differ. Uninstalling removes its local data; you may need to sign in and set up your Bluetooth key again.
setupSteps: Confirm that your existing BYD Bluetooth key can lock and unlock your car manually.
Open Me → Settings → Walk-up unlock and enable the feature. Allow nearby-device access and keep Bluetooth on.
Open Background detection and follow the instructions for your key. Supported fixed-address keys use Android’s one-time car detection setup; keys with changing addresses use broadcast detection.
Tap Calibrate distances. Measure your unlock and lock positions with the phone where you normally carry it, then save.
Enable Lock when walking away if you want automatic locking. Use Keep it ready for your phone’s background activity settings.
setupNote: Manual thresholds remain available. Calibration pauses automatic commands. Signal strength varies with pockets and surroundings; it measures signal, not an exact distance in metres.
features: BYD 9.16.1 with English, Arabic and Russian localization.
Walk-up Unlock v2.1 with a modern interface, background detection and distance calibration.
Compatibility improvements for Bluetooth keys with changing radio addresses and Samsung detection setup.
Surround View improvements: old camera requests cannot interrupt a new session, with limited automatic recovery for temporary startup failures.
Customizable bottom tabs and the existing battery-conscious detection design.
compat: Use a 64-bit ARM Android phone. The added Bluetooth detection uses Android 8+ APIs; Android Companion detection requires Android 12+ and device support. A working BYD Bluetooth key is required for automatic unlocking.
limitations: Some live content and artwork remain in Chinese. Background behavior and vehicle features vary by phone and car. After force-stopping BYD, open it again to resume detection. Camera startup still depends on the vehicle and BYD’s service.
feedback: Something not working? Include your phone, Android version, car model, app version and steps to reproduce. Remove account details, VINs and locations from screenshots or logs.
